consolidate_distance.doc: Maximal distance for points to be consolidated

consolidate_points.doc: Fuse together points with similar positions within distance

degenerate_tolerance.doc: Tolerance below which primitives are considered degenerate

delete_unused_groups.doc: Remove any groups that are empty after degenerates are removed

fix_overlaps.doc: Delete duplicate overlapping polygons sharing the same vertices

fuse_distance.doc: Legacy alias for consolidate_distance (weld points closer than this; 0 = off)

manifold_only_topology.doc: Ensure polygon topology consists of manifold patches (alias, not implemented in clean yet)

manifold_topology.doc: Ensure polygon topology consists of manifold patches (not implemented in clean yet)

orient_polygons.doc: Orient polygons so they all face consistent direction (not implemented in clean yet; use recalc_normals)

remove_attribs.doc: Alias for remove_attributes (patterns of attribute names to delete)

remove_attributes.doc: Remove attributes matching wildcard patterns (separated by spaces or commas; P is never removed)

remove_degenerate.doc: Delete degenerate primitives such as zero-area faces or zero-length curves

remove_groups.doc: Remove point or primitive groups matching wildcard patterns

remove_nans.doc: Delete points with NaN coordinates in P and primitives that reference them

remove_unused_points.doc: Discard points unused by any remaining primitive

reverse_winding.doc: Reverse vertex winding order of all primitives
